tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background and the ground behind every view. Body copy is ink or ink-muted on this surface.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Raised panels, inputs, and menus on surface where a distinct plane is needed. Text is ink or ink-muted on it.

tokens.name: surface-muted
tokens.usage: Quiet inset backgrounds (empty states, grouped metadata) on surface. Text is ink or ink-muted on it.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text, headings, and values on surface, surface-raised, and surface-muted. Contrast is at least 13.6:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, hints, sequence numbers, and timestamps on surface, surface-raised, and surface-muted. Contrast is at least 6.4:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: 1px card, input, and header borders, plus 4px expired-message and active-filter rails; a decorative edge, never the only signal of state. At least 3.23:1 on all three surfaces in both themes.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Brand identity, the header wordmark, primary button fills, and primary emphasis as text on surface, surface-raised, and surface-muted (at least 8.12:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: brand-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a brand fill, such as a primary button label. Never use it as text on a surface.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Secondary emphasis and the reveal-body link treatment on surface, surface-raised, and surface-muted (at least 5.84:1 in both themes); never the only state signal.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error text and the 4px .error rail on surface, surface-raised, and surface-muted (at least 6.59:1 in both themes). Always paired with an alert role or a word such as the error copy.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus outline, 3px solid with 2px offset, on links, buttons, inputs, selects, and focusable pre content. At least 5.77:1 on all three surfaces in both themes.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline and navigation links on surface, surface-raised, and surface-muted (at least 5.77:1 in both themes). Hover and visited keep the hue and change underline, not colour.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success and active status text on surface, surface-raised, and surface-muted (at least 5.53:1 in both themes). Always paired with a word such as Active; never the only signal.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default page copy, list summaries, table values, and control labels.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Matches summary text only; message bodies are never searched.
styles.usage: Hints, timestamps, sequence numbers, and secondary metadata.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form labels, definition terms (dt), and compact emphasis.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: The single page title. Never use it for card or section headings.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Section headings and project card titles.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Message summaries inside a timeline card.

styles.name: code
styles.sample: This message body has expired. Its metadata is retained.
styles.usage: Message body text (pre.body-text) and inline identifiers such as filter values in code.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Definition-list row gap; icon-to-label gap; the base unit of the grid.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Header padding below the rule and compact vertical control padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Definition-list column gap, active-filter rail inset, and filter row gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Page gutter, card padding, list gap, filter panel padding, and page-block separation.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Section separation and cover insets.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Large vertical separation between page blocks.

radius.note: Square-cornered in spirit; small radii soften controls and cards.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, buttons, and small raised details.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, message articles, filter panels, and the message body.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Wide panels and the largest raised surfaces; use sparingly.

shadow.note: Separation is carried by 1px borders; the card shadow is optional and absent in dark.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Optional raised card. Prefer a 1px border on surface; dark uses none and relies on the border.
